items.title: Flights agent can directly cause card charges it shouldn't have authority over (ASI03 Identity and Privilege Abuse)
Malicious flight-search content could hijack the planner agent into issuing unauthorized payments
No attributable sender identity means fraudulent charges cannot be traced back to their origin
Payment and trip details on the shared queue are readable by anything with queue access
Unauthenticated queue allows message tampering to change charge amount or recipient
